calculation.expression: mom * breadth, mom = close/close.shift(20) - 1; breadth = mean(mom > 0) across universe
calculation.description: 20d momentum of each asset multiplied by the cross-sectional fraction of assets with positive 20d momentum (market breadth). Strengthens momentum signals in broad risk-on tape and dampens them in narrow rallies. Positive IC at 10d horizon; regime-dependent (negative in 2023-24, strong otherwise).

validation.regime_notes: Validated on 15-asset cross-asset universe; 645 IC dates with >=8 valid instruments. IC by regime: 2020-22 +0.0695 (ICIR 0.190), 2023-24 -0.0151 (ICIR -0.042, adverse), 2025-26 +0.0714 (ICIR 0.185). Short-horizon (h=1) IC is weak/negative (-0.0065); use at 10d horizon only.

signal_artifact.description: Factor signal panel: rows = dates (YYYY-MM-DD), cols = 15 watchlist symbols. Recover with zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(data)).decode() -> pandas.read_csv(StringIO).
